code.AROMATIC_INVALID: The ring containing atoms {atomList} cannot be aromatic as drawn (no valid Kekulé structure).
code.ATOMS_OVERLAP: Atoms {a} and {b} occupy the same position ({distance} Å apart).
code.BOND_TOO_LONG: Bond {a}–{b} is {length} Å; expected about {expected} Å.
code.BOND_TOO_SHORT: Bond {a}–{b} is {length} Å; expected about {expected} Å.
code.CHARGE_UNUSUAL: {element} atom {atom} has an unusual formal charge of {charge}.
code.CLASH: Non-bonded atoms {a} and {b} are only {distance} Å apart (minimum {limit} Å).
code.HYPERVALENT: {element} atom {atom} uses an expanded valence ({valence}); this is allowed for period-3+ elements.
code.ISOTOPE_UNKNOWN: Mass number {isotope} is not a known isotope of {element}.
code.RADICAL: {element} atom {atom} carries {radicals, plural, one {# unpaired electron} other {# unpaired electrons}}.
code.UNDERSATURATED: {element} atom {atom} has an unpaired electron (radical); hydrogen count is too low.
code.VALENCE_EXCEEDED: {element} atom {atom} has {valence} bonds; at most {allowed} are allowed with charge {charge}.

fix.clearIsotope: Cleared the invalid isotope on atom {atom}.
fix.kekulize: Assigned a valid Kekulé structure to atoms {atoms}.
fix.moveAtom: Moved atom {atom} to a bond length of {length} Å.
fix.removeAtom: Removed hydrogen atom {atom} to free a valence.
fix.setBondOrder: Changed bond {a}–{b} from {from, select, single {single} double {double} triple {triple} aromatic {aromatic} other {{from}}} to {to, select, single {single} double {double} triple {triple} aromatic {aromatic} other {{to}}}.
fix.setCharge: Set the formal charge of {element} atom {atom} to {charge, number, ::sign-always}.
fix.setHCount: Set the hydrogen count of {element} atom {atom} to {hCount}.
